variant_definitions.full: Original physical state and all its frequencies.
variant_definitions.carrier_only: Retain the 0.502392496 line at its original site amplitudes and phases.
variant_definitions.align_carrier_phase: Rotate each site's entire analytic signal so the carrier phases coincide. This keeps envelopes and normalized residuals exactly fixed.
variant_definitions.restore_carrier_magnitude: Restore nominal carrier magnitudes, keeping the perturbed carrier phases and unnormalized residual coefficients.
variant_definitions.restore_site_scale: Rescale each entire analytic signal to the nominal carrier magnitude, keeping all instantaneous phases and normalized residuals.
variant_definitions.restore_normalized_residual: Use the nominal residual coefficients relative to the carrier, keeping perturbed carrier phases and magnitudes.
variant_definitions.omit_largest_residual_mismatch: Omit the non-carrier line with the largest normalized coefficient difference across six pairs.
variant_definitions.carrier_and_largest_residual_mismatch: Keep the carrier and the non-carrier line with the largest normalized coefficient difference.

original_mask_phase_definition: Each diagnostic variant uses the full physical signal's common envelope mask for the original_mask phase columns. Other phase columns use each variant's natural mask.

worst-g005.role: lowest pass count at main floor

first-coverage.role: lowest coverage at first coverage-failure width, floor 0.10
